title: benchmarks.py repro compare measures how alike the instances' research is, per instance and area
goal: benchmarks.py repro compare [--dir DIR] [--record] measures each instance's bare main against the start commit in a detached checkout of its own, area by area by the shas repro run recorded, running that checkout's own tools by subprocess; per instance and area it gives the articles and facts added, the tag mix (DOC, CODE, DER, COMMUNITY, UNK) of rag.py audit and the sources added; for each pair of instances it gives the Jaccard overlap of their added source urls, a plain set Jaccard of ql_research.bare_url; it gives the overlap of their added facts: a fact is shared when its best match among the other instance's facts of the same article path has a difflib ratio at or above the constant bench_repro.SAME_CLAIM (0.8), and the overlap is the matched facts over their union; a conflict is a matched pair whose factdiff.numbers differ, listed with both lines; it counts check.py errors and kb-verify lint errors per instance; it runs the orchestrator checkout's kb/public/_retrieval/repro_bench.csv with each checkout's rag.py eval, giving each instance's passed rows and coverage verdicts; its agreement figure per area is the share of the area's frozen rows on which every instance has the same verdict and the same expect_re outcome, over the areas every instance finished; repro compare --record merges its results into kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv as the scenario repro-compare, with record the start sha's first 7 characters, arm instance-N, the pair or all, case the area and the metrics articles_added, facts_added, the five tag counts, sources_added, url_jaccard, fact_overlap, conflicts, check_errors, lint_errors, eval_passed, eval_total and agreement; repro compare --dry-run lists the metrics and the instances it would read, exiting 0 with none; no new test id: the test_bench.py bundle gains a body that compares two planted instance checkouts holding one shared, one paraphrased and one conflicting fact.

notes: Premise 2026-10-15: no tool compares two clones' research; reuse factdiff.norm/words_key/unit_sim/numbers/jaccard, kbfacts.audit (rag.py --json audit), kbfacts.source_rows, ql_research.bare_url, check.py's errors= line and .claude/skills/kb-verify/lint.py --json --base START. The test bundle passes before the work: it pins the new bodies once they are added; the checks that fail before the work are the repro subcommands.
